## Triage: closed `not_planned` on first touch. A PM-tooling finding with neither queue-entry line

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-13T11:05Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why it closes:** it is a finding about PM or gate tooling (`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`). It has no `Unblocks: #N` naming an open product card it blocks, and no published surface it guards. The product-only queue rule closes it on first touch.

- **Re-entry:** a new card whose first line is `Unblocks: #N` (an open product card measured blocked by it), or the maintainer directing the fix.
- The handoff item is recorded. Nothing is lost by closing.
